def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Find connected line components made of 1s and 2s.
    seen = set()
    lines = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] not in (1, 2) or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w
                            and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]] in (1, 2)):
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            lines.append(cells)

    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    if not markers or not lines:
        return [[2 if v == 1 else v for v in row] for row in grid]

    # The 1/2 strokes become solid 2s.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if out[r][c] == 1:
                out[r][c] = 2

    def paint(y, x):
        if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w and out[y][x] in (8, 3):
            out[y][x] = 3

    def segment(y1, x1, y2, x2):
        if y1 == y2:
            for x in range(min(x1, x2), max(x1, x2) + 1):
                paint(y1, x)
        elif x1 == x2:
            for y in range(min(y1, y2), max(y1, y2) + 1):
                paint(y, x1)

    mr, mc = markers[0]
    horizontal = all(len({r for r, c in cells}) == 1 for cells in lines)

    if horizontal:
        # Each horizontal stroke has a parallel 3-line offset above/below it.
        above = mr < min(min(r for r, c in cells) for cells in lines)
        ordered = sorted(lines, key=lambda cells: cells[0][0], reverse=not above)
        direction_axis = 1 if above else -1

        def nearest_endpoint(cells, source):
            xs = [c for r, c in cells]
            lo, hi = min(xs), max(xs)
            dl, dh = abs(source - lo), abs(source - hi)
            if dl != dh:
                return -1 if dl < dh else 1
            ones = [c for r, c in cells if grid[r][c] == 1]
            nl = min((abs(c - lo) for c in ones), default=0)
            nh = min((abs(c - hi) for c in ones), default=0)
            return -1 if nl > nh else 1

        first_dir = nearest_endpoint(ordered[0], mc)
        prev_x, prev_y = mc, mr

        for i, cells in enumerate(ordered):
            row = cells[0][0]
            d = sum(grid[r][c] == 1 for r, c in cells) + 1
            yline = row - d if above else row + d
            xs = [c for r, c in cells]
            lo, hi = min(xs) - d, max(xs) + d
            lo, hi = max(0, lo), min(w - 1, hi)
            direction = first_dir * (-1 if i % 2 else 1)
            end_x = hi if direction > 0 else lo

            if i == 0:
                segment(mr, mc, yline, mc)
            else:
                segment(prev_y, prev_x, yline, prev_x)
            segment(yline, prev_x, yline, end_x)
            prev_x, prev_y = end_x, yline

        segment(prev_y, prev_x, h - 1 if above else 0, prev_x)

    else:
        # Vertical strokes use the same construction, rotated 90 degrees.
        left = mc < min(min(c for r, c in cells) for cells in lines)
        ordered = sorted(lines, key=lambda cells: cells[0][1], reverse=not left)

        def nearest_endpoint(cells, source):
            ys = [r for r, c in cells]
            lo, hi = min(ys), max(ys)
            dl, dh = abs(source - lo), abs(source - hi)
            if dl != dh:
                return -1 if dl < dh else 1
            ones = [r for r, c in cells if grid[r][c] == 1]
            nl = min((abs(r - lo) for r in ones), default=0)
            nh = min((abs(r - hi) for r in ones), default=0)
            return -1 if nl > nh else 1

        first_dir = nearest_endpoint(ordered[0], mr)
        prev_y, prev_x = mr, mc

        for i, cells in enumerate(ordered):
            col = cells[0][1]
            d = sum(grid[r][c] == 1 for r, c in cells) + 1
            xline = col - d if left else col + d
            ys = [r for r, c in cells]
            lo, hi = min(ys) - d, max(ys) + d
            lo, hi = max(0, lo), min(h - 1, hi)
            direction = first_dir * (-1 if i % 2 else 1)
            end_y = hi if direction > 0 else lo

            if i == 0:
                segment(mr, mc, mr, xline)
            else:
                segment(prev_y, prev_x, prev_y, xline)
            segment(prev_y, xline, end_y, xline)
            prev_y, prev_x = end_y, xline

        segment(prev_y, prev_x, prev_y, w - 1 if left else 0)

    return out
